mapper.select: SELECT * FROM channel WHERE id = #{id} AND active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel (channel_name, channel_code, contact_person, contact_phone, commission_rate, active, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{channelName}, #{channelCode}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{commissionRate}, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE channel SET channel_name = #{channelName}, channel_code = #{channelCode}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, commission_rate = #{commissionRate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE channel SET active = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
